ranks.desc: Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for $<heal>. Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.
